目标 — 本服务器上的服务: Destination — a service on this server
目标地址与本服务器公网 IP 相同；如果目标服务就在本机，选择『本机』模式更可靠: The destination has the same IP as this server; if the service runs here, Local machine mode is more reliable (many networks do not support hairpinning, a server connecting to its own public address)
目标地址指向本中转自身，会形成转发循环: The destination points at this relay itself and would create a forwarding loop
目标就是本中转的公网入口，会形成转发循环: The destination is this relay's own public entry and would create a forwarding loop

端口 %d 不在已保存的 NAT 范围 %d-%d 内，请确认商家确实映射了此端: Port %d is outside the saved NAT range %d-%d; make sure your provider really maps it
端口可达不代表代理协议可用；请再用实际客户端连接公网入口验证: A reachable port does not prove the proxy protocol works; also test with a real client against the public entry
节点引用的出站代理与配置不一致: A node's outbound proxy reference does not match the configuration
节点编号，可多选，如 1 3，或 all（0 返回）: Node numbers, several allowed, e.g. 1 3, or all (0 to go back)
计量中断后已暂停：可选择『保留已知用量并恢复』: Paused after a metering gap: choose "Resume with known usage"
计量中断期间的流量无法统计：恢复后继续按已知用量计算限额: Traffic during the gap cannot be counted: after resuming, the limit continues from the usage already counted
请输入数字（GB），例如 100；或 0 表示不限: Enter a number in GB, e.g. 100, or 0 for unlimited
请输入有效的 IP 地址或域名（IPv6 可直接输入，不需要方括号）: Enter a valid IP address or domain (IPv6 works without brackets)
转发到本服务器上的另一个端口或服务: Forward traffic to another port or service on this server.
输入 %s 确认，其他任意输入取消: Type %s to confirm; anything else cancels
输出全部连接链接，或保存到文件: Print every connection link, or save them to a file
输出连接链接，或保存 sing-box 客户端配置: Print the connection link, or save a sing-box client configuration
达到 %s 后此节点会自动停止（其他节点不受影响），下次重置后自动恢复\n: After %s this node stops automatically (other nodes are not affected) and resumes after the next reset
这批节点的出站（同一批节点使用相同出站）：: Outbound for this batch (every node in it uses the same one):
远程服务器 IP 或域名（也可以粘贴远程节点的分享链接）: Remote server IP or hostname (or paste the remote node's share link)
远程服务器上的目标端口: Destination port on the remote server
选择出站代理编号（0 返回）: Outbound proxy number (0 to go back)
选择出站（0 返回）: Choose the outbound (0 to go back)
选择节点编号查看或设置限额（0 返回）: Node number to view or set its limit (0 to go back)
通过中转执行完整协议测试: Run a full protocol test through the relay
配置有效：%d 个节点或中转，%d 个出站代理: Configuration valid: %d node(s) or relay(s), %d outbound proxy(ies)
重新校验并应用全部配置（会依次重启所有节点和中转）: Validate and re-apply everything (restarts every node and relay in turn)
重置后旧链接立即失效，需要重新导入客户端链接: After a reset the old link stops working immediately; clients must import the new link
商家分配的内部端口范围（本机监听端口，如 20000-20019）: Internal port range assigned by your provider (listening ports on this server, e.g. 20000-20019)
内部端口 %d 对应的公网端口（两者相同就直接回车）: Public port mapped to internal port %d (press Enter if they are the same)
%s：计量缺口保护暂停（流量与限额 → 保留已知用量并恢复）: %s: paused by a metering gap (Traffic and limits → Resume with known usage)
输入编号 · 0 或 b 返回 · q 退出 Rout: Enter a number · 0 or b = back · q = quit Rout
输入编号 · 0 或 q 退出 Rout: Enter a number · 0 or q = quit Rout
公网入口 %s → 本机监听 %s → 目标 %s（%s）: Public entry %s → listening on this server %s → destination %s (%s)
公网 IP：%s（客户端连接此地址；可在 设置 → 服务器类型与默认设置 中修改: Public IP: %s (clients connect here; change it in Settings → Server type and defaults)
使用此监听地址和端口: Use this listening address and port
没有可自动分配的端口，请手动填写: No port can be assigned automatically; enter one manually
HY2/TUIC 使用自动生成的自签证书（高级选项中可改用现有 PEM 证书）: HY2/TUIC use an automatically generated self-signed certificate (Advanced options can switch to an existing PEM certificate)
下载的内核无法在本机运行，已保留原有文件: The downloaded engine cannot run on this machine; the existing file was kept
仅当客户端网络支持 IPv6: Only if the client's network supports IPv6
公网地址：%s（客户端连接此地址；可在 设置 → 服务器地址 中修改）\n: Public address: %s (clients connect here; change it in Settings → Server address)
公网端口：%d（与监听端口相同）\n: Public port: %d (same as the listening port)
另一个内核安装仍在进行，请稍后重试: Another engine installation is still running; try again shortly
地址无效：不能是空值、未指定地址或链路本地地址（如 fe80::）: Invalid address: it cannot be empty, an unspecified address or a link-local address (such as fe80::)
客户端连接使用的地址；写入分享链接（仅当需要改为监听 IPv6 时才会重启节点）: The address clients connect to; written into share links (the node restarts only if it must start listening on IPv6)
尚未保存服务器设置；创建节点时会自动检测。: No server settings are saved yet; they are detected automatically when you create a node.
手动填写 IP 或域名: Enter an IP or domain manually
手动指定监听端口；会检查 TCP 和 UDP 是否被占用: Choose the listening ports yourself; TCP and UDP availability is checked
改为监听 ::（IPv4 与 IPv6 同时可用，会重启节点）: Listen on :: instead (IPv4 and IPv6 both work; restarts the node)
改用普通 VPS 后，新节点的公网端口等于监听端口。已有的 NAT 节点和中转保: After switching, new nodes use the listening port as their public port. Existing NAT nodes and relays stay as they are and their port mappings are not rewritten; editing them later still asks for the provider-mapped public port.
改用普通 VPS（公网端口 = 监听端口）: Switch to a regular VPS (public port = listening port)
无法自动检测公网地址，请手动填写: The public address could not be detected; enter it manually
旧版 NAT 映射仍在使用，已有的 NAT 节点和中转不会被改动。: The legacy NAT mapping is still in use; existing NAT nodes and relays are not changed.
旧版 NAT 映射：公网端口由商家映射，可能与监听端口不同: Legacy NAT mapping: the provider maps the public port, which may differ from the listening port
本服务器同时有 IPv4 和 IPv6，客户端使用哪个地址连接？: This server has both IPv4 and IPv6. Which address should clients connect to?
本机无法在同一监听上同时接受 IPv4 和 IPv6，保持 IPv4: This host cannot accept IPv4 and IPv6 on one listener; keeping IPv4
此服务器沿用旧版 NAT 端口映射，新节点和中转也按该映射分配端口；改用普通 V: This server keeps its legacy NAT port mapping and new nodes and relays follow it; to switch to a regular VPS: Settings → Server address
端口和认证凭据已自动生成: Ports and credentials were generated automatically
自定义凭据、Reality SNI、使用现有 PEM 证书: Custom credentials, Reality SNI, an existing PEM certificate
该节点目前只监听 IPv4，IPv6 地址无法连接: This node currently listens on IPv4 only, so its IPv6 address cannot connect
重新检测并选择 IPv4 / IPv6: Detect again and choose IPv4 / IPv6
AI 出口可用，实际出口 IP：%s: AI exit works; actual exit IP: %s
AI 出口必须是 SOCKS5 或 HTTP 出站代理: The AI exit must be a SOCKS5 or HTTP outbound proxy
AI 出口指向本机上的 %s，会形成路由循环: The AI exit points at %s on this server, which would create a routing loop
仅 UDP 的 Shadowsocks 无法承载 AI 服务的 TCP 流量: UDP-only Shadowsocks cannot carry the TCP traffic of AI services
尚未选择入站节点：目前不会影响任何节点: No inbound nodes selected: no node is affected at the moment
尚未配置 AI 智能分流: AI Smart Routing is not configured yet
引用检查通过：入站和 AI 出口均有效: Reference check passed: inbounds and AI exit are valid
所选 AI 出口已不存在: The selected AI exit no longer exists
未安装 sing-box 内核，跳过配置语法检查: sing-box is not installed; skipping the configuration syntax check
端口转发（中转）没有路由规则，不能绑定 AI 智能分流: Port forwarding entries have no routing rules and cannot be bound to AI Smart Routing
AI 出口不可用时，AI 域名的连接会失败（不会静默改走原有出口），请选择“选择: If the AI exit is unavailable, connections to AI domains fail (they are never silently sent through the original exit); choose "Select AI exit" to change it
AI 智能分流已停用，已绑定节点恢复原有路由: AI Smart Routing disabled; bound nodes use their original routing again
AI 智能分流当前未启用，绑定将在启用后生效: AI Smart Routing is currently disabled; the binding takes effect once it is enabled
GitHub Copilot 的令牌请求发往 api.github.com，为避: GitHub Copilot token requests go to api.github.com; it is not in the rules so that ordinary GitHub traffic is not affected
仅按域名判断：客户端只发送 IP、使用 ECH 加密握手或域名无法获取的连接，无: Matching is by domain only: connections where the client sends just an IP, uses an ECH encrypted handshake, or exposes no domain cannot be recognized and use the original route
以上是对规则的模拟；真实网络效果请参考手动验收清单: This simulates the rules only; for real network behavior follow the manual acceptance checklist
停用 AI 智能分流（会重启 %d 个已绑定节点，恢复其原有路由；设置会保留）: Disable AI Smart Routing (restarts %d bound nodes and restores their original routing; settings are kept)
出口当前不可用，仍然选择它: The exit is unavailable right now; select it anyway
只会重启已绑定的节点；其他节点和入站配置不受影响: Only bound nodes are restarted; other nodes and inbound settings are not affected
只会重启绑定状态发生变化的节点；未绑定的节点不受影响: Only nodes whose binding changed are restarted; unbound nodes are not affected
启用 AI 智能分流（会重启 %d 个已绑定节点）: Enable AI Smart Routing (restarts %d bound nodes)
域名识别：已绑定节点启用嗅探（TLS SNI、HTTP Host、QUIC），客: Domain detection: bound nodes sniff TLS SNI, HTTP Host and QUIC, so destinations are recognized whether the client sends a domain or only an IP
尚未选择入站节点：启用后不会影响任何节点: No inbound nodes selected: enabling it will not affect any node
无法识别的情况：ECH 加密握手、纯 IP 且无嗅探信息的连接；这些连接走原有路: Not recognizable: ECH encrypted handshakes and IP-only connections without sniffable data; these use the original route
暂无出站代理。请先在“出站代理”中创建 AI 出口（例如位于加拿大的 SOCKS: No outbound proxies yet. Create the AI exit first under "Outbound proxies" (for example a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy in Canada)
暂无可绑定的节点，请先创建节点: No nodes to bind yet; create a node first
有 %d 个节点的配置与已保存的设置不一致，请选择“应用更改”: %d nodes do not match the saved settings; choose "Apply changes"
此出站代理不能作为 AI 出口: This outbound proxy cannot be used as the AI exit
没有选择任何入站：AI 智能分流不会影响任何节点: No inbound selected: AI Smart Routing will not affect any node
绑定的入站 %s 已不存在，保存时将移除: Bound inbound %s no longer exists and will be removed when saving
规则按域名后缀匹配（含子域名），只列出 AI 服务专用的域名，不包含 googl: Rules match domain suffixes (subdomains included) and list only domains dedicated to AI services, never whole-site domains such as google.com or github.com
规则集不能保证覆盖全部 AI 流量；后续版本会更新规则，更新后请选择“应用更改”: The rule set cannot guarantee coverage of all AI traffic; later releases update it, after which choose "Apply changes"
输入一个域名，查看各节点会如何路由（规则模拟，不发起真实请求；留空跳过）: Enter a domain to see how each node would route it (rule simulation, no real request; leave empty to skip)
输入编号切换选中，可多个，如 1 3 · s 保存 · 0 取消: Enter numbers to toggle, several allowed, e.g. 1 3 · s save · 0 cancel
选择 AI 出口编号（0 返回）: Select the AI exit number (0 to go back)
配置存在问题，请先修复；当前运行中的节点不受此测试影响: The configuration has problems; fix them first. Running nodes are not affected by this test
重新校验并应用 AI 智能分流，并更新到最新规则集（会重启 %d 个已绑定节点）: Re-validate and apply AI Smart Routing and update to the newest rule set (restarts %d bound nodes)
针对 AI 域名的 UDP（如 QUIC）会被拒绝，让客户端回退到 TCP；AI: UDP to AI domains (such as QUIC) is rejected so clients fall back to TCP; the AI exit forwards TCP only
AI 智能分流：菜单、状态、测试配置或重新应用: AI Smart Routing: menu, status, test the configuration, or re-apply
出站代理正被 AI 智能分流用作 AI 出口，请先在 AI 智能分流中更换: This outbound proxy is the AI exit of AI Smart Routing; change the AI exit first
复制链接或导出客户端配置: Copy link or export client configuration
选择协议，可多选，如 1 2（0 取消）: Select protocols, multiple allowed, e.g. 1 2 (0 to cancel)
基础节点名称（仅填写一次，例如 Tokyo；输入 0 取消）: Base node name (asked once, e.g. Tokyo; enter 0 to cancel)
输入节点编号查看详情和链接 · q 退出 Rout: Enter a node number for its link and actions · q quit Rout
AI 出口必须是 SOCKS5、HTTP 或 HTTPS 出站代理: The AI exit must be a SOCKS5, HTTP or HTTPS outbound proxy
SOCKS5/HTTP 出站链路未加密，账号密码可能被窃听；旧配置保持原样。请显: SOCKS5/HTTP outbound transport is unencrypted; credentials may be intercepted. Existing settings are preserved. Explicitly switch to certificate-verified HTTPS CONNECT or carry SOCKS5 through SSH (see docs/AI_ROUTING.md)
域名识别：优先匹配客户端提交的域名；IP 目标仅在 TLS SNI、HTTP H: Domain detection: match the explicit destination first; IP targets can only be identified when TLS SNI, HTTP Host or supported QUIC exposes the domain
